description: Dashboard-to-mobile parity manifest (MOBILE_APP_PLAN.md, Parity enforcement). Generated by scripts/mobile/generate-parity-manifest.py; statuses, screens, workstreams, and notes are maintained by hand once an entry exists.

entries.notes: mobile path /home; HomeScreen (Work tab root on phones, followed by the Work destinations)

Approvals tab root: the approvals center (NeedsYouScreen): Ask proposals, CLI permissions, mission reviews, deployment approvals with inline decisions; failed landings, failed missions, stalled captains with their fix; recent alerts (TUI has the same route)

two mobile routes: /ask and /ask/:threadId (AskScreen); phones open the conversation list as a sheet, tablets split list and conversation; /ask reopens the last conversation once per app session; the captain picker is an inline dropdown under the captain bar; replies show the turn duration and tool times (as AskMessageView and the tool chips do) plus an (i) Turn statistics panel with the same numbers (shared lib/chatMetrics)
CaptainsHubScreen: Captains and Docks tabs; tablets split list and detail
CaptainDetailScreen: captain chat panel, CLI permission policy in place, tool access, log
DispatchHubScreen; dashboard router-state prefill arrives as query parameters (?from=vessel&vesselId=...)
FleetActionsScreen; ?run=new and ?run=new&vessels=<ids> start the run flow
FleetDetailView: edit, duplicate, View JSON, delete; vessels open /vessels/:id
NeedsYouScreen: the Needs You inbox with decisions in place (same screen as the Approvals tab root)
More tab root: CONFIGURATION, ACTIVITY, SYSTEM, and app settings (phone navigation)
